question: What is Diginex

beats.line: Diginex is repositioning as one sustainability, data and compliance platform.
beats.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beats.action: A halftone paper screen lowers onto a cream chip and holds centre frame.

beats.line: Its software helps organisations collect, manage and report climate data.
beats.headline: ESG DATA
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the screen tilts back and stacked documents feed into it, settling in a neat pile.

beats.line: Four separate businesses have now been absorbed into it.
beats.headline: 4 BUSINESSES
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the document pile splits into four paper folders; tape pieces bind them into one block.

beats.line: Carbon accounting, supply chains, human rights, now AI customer data.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the taped block unfolds into a paper conveyor that runs from one edge to the other and stops.

beats.line: It is built to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.
beats.headline: BANKS & FUNDS
beats.action: The previous chip slides down as the conveyor's far end folds up into cutout buildings that line up and hold.

beats.line: The stock trades at one dollar sixteen, capitalised near thirty-four million.
beats.action: The previous chip flips off as the buildings collapse into paper coins; a torn-paper arrow enters and points down at them.

beats.line: Administrative costs rose three point four million, to eight point one.
beats.headline: $8.1M G&A
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top as the down arrow straightens into a rising paper column; coins stack up its side and stop.

beats.line: Integration execution across those four businesses is the primary risk.
beats.headline: EXECUTION RISK
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the column topples into four leaning folders; a paper hand enters and steadies them.

beats.line: Winning banks and proving Resulticks synergies would change the story.
beats.headline: WHAT CHANGES IT
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the steadying hand unrolls a paper ribbon that loops around cutout buildings and ties.

beats.line: It is targeting Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market.
beats.headline: $77B MARKET
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the tied ribbon flattens into a paper map; a cutout arrow lands on it and holds.
